functions.name: active_stock_binding_guard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core_registry_private.active_stock_binding_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE', 'TRUNCATE') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_binding_history_retained'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.company_portal_instances i JOIN public.companies c ON c.id = i.company_id
      WHERE i.id = NEW.instance_id AND c.id = NEW.company_id AND c.status = 'active' AND i.portal_type = 'stock')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core_e1_resource_private.origins e WHERE e.reservation_id = NEW.instance_id)
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.company_memberships m WHERE m.company_id = NEW.company_id
        AND m.core_auth_user_id = NEW.control_subject_id AND m.status = 'active' AND m.role = 'owner')
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM core_registry_private.operators o
          WHERE o.subject_id IN (NEW.first_operator, NEW.second_operator) AND o.active
            AND o.valid_until > clock_timestamp()) <> 2
      OR NEW.approved_at > clock_timestamp() OR NEW.status <> 'active' OR NEW.revision <> 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'independent_existing_binding_control_required';
    END IF;
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    IF OLD.status <> 'active' OR NEW.status <> 'revoked' OR NEW.revision <> OLD.revision + 1
      OR (to_jsonb(NEW) - 'status' - 'revision' - 'revoked_at') IS DISTINCT FROM
         (to_jsonb(OLD) - 'status' - 'revision' - 'revoked_at') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_binding_immutable';
    END IF;
    NEW.revoked_at := clock_timestamp();
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: active_stock_core_session_live

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core_registry_private.active_stock_core_session_live(p_subject uuid, p_session uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.sessions s JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = s.user_id
    WHERE s.id = p_session AND s.user_id = p_subject AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND (u.banned_until IS NULL OR u.banned_until <= statement_timestamp())
      AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after > statement_timestamp()))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.oauth_consents c WHERE c.user_id = p_subject
      AND c.client_id = 'fe3e0af9-2d84-4ec2-a750-b26bb4a81caf'::uuid AND c.revoked_at IS NULL);
$function$

functions.name: active_stock_current_binding
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core_registry_private.active_stock_current_binding(p_binding uuid, p_subject uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT coalesce((SELECT runtime_enabled FROM core_registry_private.active_stock_settings WHERE singleton), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_stock_runtime_disabled';
  END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('bindingId', b.id, 'bindingRevision', b.revision,
    'companyId', c.id, 'companyRevision', c.revision, 'instanceId', i.id,
    'coreTenantId', b.core_tenant_id, 'stockTenantId', b.stock_tenant_id)
  INTO STRICT v_result
  FROM core_registry_private.active_stock_bindings b
  JOIN public.companies c ON c.id = b.company_id
  JOIN public.company_portal_instances i ON i.id = b.instance_id AND i.company_id = c.id
  JOIN public.company_memberships m ON m.company_id = c.id AND m.core_auth_user_id = p_subject
  WHERE b.id = p_binding AND b.status = 'active' AND b.revoked_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'active'
    AND m.status = 'active' AND m.role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'member') AND i.portal_type = 'stock'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core_e1_resource_private.origins e WHERE e.reservation_id = i.id);
  RETURN v_result;
END $function$

functions.name: current_authority
functions.arguments: p_binding uuid, p_subject uuid, p_pending boolean
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core_stock_pilot_private.current_authority(p_binding uuid, p_subject uuid, p_pending boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE a core_stock_pilot_private.authority%ROWTYPE; revision bigint; fault text;
BEGIN
  SELECT x.* INTO STRICT a FROM core_stock_pilot_private.authority x
    JOIN core_stock_pilot_private.cohort c ON c.email=x.cohort_email AND c.core_subject=x.core_subject
      AND c.enabled AND c.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
    JOIN core_stock_pilot_private.entitlements e ON e.binding_id=x.id AND e.revoked_at IS NULL AND e.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
    WHERE x.id=p_binding AND x.core_subject=p_subject AND x.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND (x.state='confirmed' OR (p_pending AND x.state='prepared'));
  SELECT failure_mode INTO STRICT fault FROM core_stock_pilot_private.cohort WHERE email=a.cohort_email;
  IF fault='deny' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pilot_injected_outage'; END IF;
  IF fault='timeout' THEN PERFORM pg_sleep(4); RAISE EXCEPTION 'pilot_injected_timeout'; END IF;
  SELECT c.revision INTO STRICT revision FROM core_e1_resource_private.origins o
    JOIN core_e1_resource_private.stock_bindings b ON b.reservation_id=o.reservation_id
    JOIN public.companies c ON c.id=o.company_id AND c.status='active'
    JOIN public.company_memberships m ON m.id=o.membership_id AND m.company_id=c.id
      AND m.core_auth_user_id=o.core_subject AND m.status='active' AND m.role='owner'
    JOIN public.company_portal_instances i ON i.id=o.reservation_id AND i.company_id=c.id AND i.portal_type='stock'
    WHERE o.company_id=a.company_id AND o.reservation_id=a.instance_id AND o.core_subject=a.core_subject
      AND o.core_tenant_id=a.core_tenant_id AND o.source='core.e1.resource.v1'
      AND b.stock_tenant_id=a.stock_tenant_id AND b.stock_subject=a.stock_subject AND b.profile_id=a.profile_id
      AND b.stock_audit_event_id=a.stock_birth_audit
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.company_memberships WHERE core_auth_user_id=p_subject)=1;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('bindingId',a.id,'bindingRevision',a.revision,'companyId',a.company_id,
    'companyRevision',revision,'instanceId',a.instance_id,'coreTenantId',a.core_tenant_id,'stockTenantId',a.stock_tenant_id);
END $function$

functions.name: existing_enroll_session
functions.arguments: p_company uuid, p_instance uuid, p_core_subject uuid, p_core_session uuid, p_stock_subject uuid, p_stock_session uuid, p_verified_until timestamp with time zone, p_core_token_expires timestamp with time zone
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core_stock_pilot_private.existing_enroll_session(p_company uuid, p_instance uuid, p_core_subject uuid, p_core_session uuid, p_stock_subject uuid, p_stock_session uuid, p_verified_until timestamp with time zone, p_core_token_expires timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_binding uuid; v_authority jsonb; v_session core_registry_private.active_stock_sessions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_core_subject IS NULL OR p_core_session IS NULL OR p_stock_subject IS NULL OR p_stock_session IS NULL
    OR p_verified_until IS NULL OR p_verified_until <= clock_timestamp()
    OR p_verified_until > clock_timestamp() + interval '30 seconds'
    OR p_core_token_expires IS NULL OR p_core_token_expires <= clock_timestamp()
    OR NOT core_registry_private.active_stock_core_session_live(p_core_subject, p_core_session) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_stock_identity_denied';
  END IF;
  IF p_company IS NULL AND p_instance IS NULL THEN
    -- The ordinary Stock sign-in entry supplies no Company/resource selector.
    -- Current membership and the unique independently approved binding select
    -- exactly one resource. Missing or ambiguous authority raises and denies.
    SELECT b.id INTO STRICT v_binding FROM core_registry_private.active_stock_bindings b
      JOIN public.company_memberships m ON m.company_id=b.company_id
      WHERE m.core_auth_user_id=p_core_subject AND m.status='active'
        AND m.role IN ('owner','admin','member') AND b.status='active' AND b.revoked_at IS NULL;
  ELSE
    SELECT id INTO STRICT v_binding FROM core_registry_private.active_stock_bindings
      WHERE company_id = p_company AND instance_id = p_instance;
  END IF;
  v_authority := core_registry_private.active_stock_current_binding(v_binding, p_core_subject);
  INSERT INTO core_registry_private.active_stock_sessions(stock_subject, stock_session_id, binding_id,
    core_subject, core_session_id, expires_at)
    VALUES (p_stock_subject, p_stock_session, v_binding, p_core_subject, p_core_session,
      least(p_core_token_expires, clock_timestamp() + interval '1 hour'))
    ON CONFLICT (stock_subject, stock_session_id) DO NOTHING;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_session FROM core_registry_private.active_stock_sessions
    WHERE stock_subject = p_stock_subject AND stock_session_id = p_stock_session FOR UPDATE;
  IF v_session.binding_id <> v_binding OR v_session.core_subject <> p_core_subject
    OR v_session.core_session_id <> p_core_session OR v_session.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
    OR v_session.expires_at <= clock_timestamp() OR p_verified_until <= clock_timestamp() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_stock_session_conflict';
  END IF;
  RETURN v_authority || jsonb_build_object('coreSubject', p_core_subject, 'coreSessionId', p_core_session);
END $function$

functions.name: guard_history
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core_stock_pilot_private.guard_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP IN ('DELETE','TRUNCATE') OR TG_TABLE_NAME='audit' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pilot_history_retained'; END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='authority' THEN
    IF OLD.state='revoked' OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
      OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'-'revision'-'confirmed_at'-'revoked_at') IS DISTINCT FROM
         (to_jsonb(OLD)-'state'-'revision'-'confirmed_at'-'revoked_at')
      OR NOT ((OLD.state='prepared' AND NEW.state='confirmed' AND NEW.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NULL)
        OR (NEW.state='revoked' AND NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.confirmed_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.confirmed_at))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pilot_authority_immutable'; END IF;
  ELSE
    IF OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.revoked_at IS NULL
      OR to_jsonb(NEW)-'revoked_at' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(OLD)-'revoked_at'
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pilot_record_immutable'; END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: core_registry_session_is_live
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.core_registry_session_is_live()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE subject uuid := auth.uid(); claims jsonb := auth.jwt(); sid uuid;
BEGIN
  IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR subject IS NULL
    OR jsonb_typeof(claims->'session_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
    OR (claims->>'session_id') !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    OR jsonb_typeof(claims->'exp') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR (claims->>'exp')::numeric <= extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  sid := (claims->>'session_id')::uuid;
  RETURN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.sessions s JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=s.user_id
    WHERE s.id=sid AND s.user_id=subject AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after>clock_timestamp())
      AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND (u.banned_until IS NULL OR u.banned_until<=clock_timestamp()));
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

AS $function$
BEGIN

   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core_stock_pilot_private.authority WHERE stock_subject=p_stock_subject OR core_subject=p_core_subject)
 THEN RETURN core_stock_pilot_private.authorize(p_stock_subject,p_stock_session,p_core_subject,p_verified_until); END IF;
 RETURN core_stock_pilot_private.existing_authorize_request(p_stock_subject,p_stock_session,p_core_subject,p_verified_until);
END $function$
